summary: Rather than spend the last of the window on another no-op, I turned the one durable finding of this run's final receipt into reviewable knowledge: the end of a removed leader's read exposure does not follow from the quorum option but from a replacement leader being elected. In the single-voter remainder the remaining voter elects itself and under PreVote the voters grant a new election, so the removed leader learns of the higher term after one heartbeat tick; with CheckQuorum and a remainder of more than one voter the voters keep answering the removed leader's heartbeats, refuse each other's votes inside their leases and elect nobody, so it keeps leading, keeps its lease, and completes later read-only rounds from its own frozen commit index - rounds it began by counting its own acknowledgement although it is not a voter of the configuration whose quorum the round needed. The entry cites the source ranges for that path and the parsed events (1-4) of check 11c411f5, and validation reports valid with a knowledge entry created. The remaining open measurement is still the one I recorded last turn: whether the voters of such a remainder elect a replacement once their own election timers run.
